acceptance.criterion: Each screen classified flow or shell per breakpoint, measured against its own source — not against an ADR sentence. Applied with the screen-scroll() mixin (%app-screen and %screen-footer were struck) rather than re-authored
acceptance.evidence: Classification re-confirmed against current source in the file's own rewritten header comment (milestones.scss:1-32): :host is display:block (flow) until @include layout.respond-to('lg') flips it to display:flex; height:100% — matches ADR-0043 §5's own naming of milestones as the per-breakpoint case. Per hub ADR-0043 §4a (landed after this slice's prior escalation), the screen-scroll() mixin is not what applies here at all: '.screen-scroll' (private-layout.scss's own wrapper) is a layout-owned bounding box the screen never touches; a screen's own pane extends screen-scroll() only if it hands its single scroller to the layout, which milestones deliberately does not (it keeps two independent panes, .list and .detail-body, per the prompt's explicit instruction and ADR-0043 §5's own text: 'one whose .list and .detail-body panes keep their own scrollers rather than surrendering them'). Nothing was re-authored: .list/.detail-body's declarations are byte-for-byte unchanged from before this slice (git diff shows zero lines touched in either rule).
acceptance.notes: The mixin clause in this bullet predates ADR-0043 §4a's clarification that milestones' own panes never use screen-scroll() at all — satisfied in spirit (nothing re-authored, existing primitives reused elsewhere in this same slice: %truncating-flex-child, %eyebrow-wide) rather than literally, because the model that bullet was written against changed underneath it.

acceptance.criterion: Corrected premise, 2026-09-04 — milestones is the real per-breakpoint screen: :host is display: block at base and takes height: 100% only at 663 [now re-measured], with .list scrolling inside that @media; its unconditional overflow-y: auto is .detail-body, a pane. Re-measure each screen before migrating it — this task's list was wrong once already
acceptance.evidence: Re-confirmed against current source before touching anything (unchanged from this slice's own prior partial-report measurement, since no line moved in the interim except this slice's own edits): :host display:block at milestones.scss:17-21; @include layout.respond-to('lg') (was @media (min-width:900px)) opens at line 693 in the pre-edit file, flips :host to display:flex;height:100% (694-698); .list's overflow-y:auto is declared only inside that same block (line 725, formerly 715); .detail-body's overflow-y:auto (line 517, formerly 520) is unconditional, both breakpoints, and is a pane per the file's own T347-authored header comment. This slice's route change (screenScroll:'lg') and CSS migration (respond-to, tokens, extends) match this classification exactly — no line of .list/.detail-body moved.
